items.answer: src/ratings/notch.mjs, two named exports. RATING_SCALE: the 19 ratings exactly as in C1, best first (index 0 'AAA' … 18 'CCC-'). notchChange(previous, current): synchronous integer = index(current) − index(previous), range −18..+18, positive downgrade, negative upgrade, 0 unchanged (never −0). Each argument is trimmed with String.prototype.trim() and matched case-insensitively. Missing/null/undefined arguments are non-strings → RangeError.

Every invalid input throws RangeError, checked per argument: unknown rating ('D','CC','AAA+','BBB +'), empty or whitespace-only string, any non-string (undefined, null, number, boolean, object, array, Symbol, String object). Non-strings are rejected before .trim() so never surface as TypeError. No fallback value.
items.quote: A String object such as `new String('A')` is a non-string.

items.answer: Only String.prototype.trim() removes whitespace (leading/trailing, incl. \t \n U+00A0 U+FEFF); '\tA-\n' equals 'A-'. Whitespace-only trims to '' → RangeError. Internal whitespace stays, so 'BBB +' is unknown → RangeError.
